A 'Content Strategist' combines both into a review angle, which she adjusts, and other agents automatically pick up that direction without re-explaining the data. The final output is presented as a clear, evidence-based answer to 'Is this pool robot actually worth buying?' including a full review plan, hook script, and shortlist, all tied to her actual testing.
